MIRA Web Workbench — third-party runtime licenses

PixiJS 8.19.0 is bundled into the local browser JavaScript. The following
locked PixiJS runtime dependency packages are also incorporated into the
bundle as applicable. Full copyright and license texts are included in the
adjacent files and are served with the application at /assets/licenses/.

- pixi.js 8.19.0 — MIT — pixi.js-8.19.0-MIT.txt
- @pixi/colord 2.9.6 — MIT — pixi-colord-2.9.6-MIT.txt
- @xmldom/xmldom 0.8.15 — MIT — xmldom-0.8.15-MIT.txt
- earcut 3.2.4 — ISC — earcut-3.2.4-ISC.txt
- eventemitter3 5.0.4 — MIT — eventemitter3-5.0.4-MIT.txt
- gifuct-js 2.1.2 — MIT — gifuct-js-2.1.2-MIT.txt
- ismobilejs 1.1.1 — MIT — ismobilejs-1.1.1-MIT.txt
- js-binary-schema-parser 2.0.3 — MIT — js-binary-schema-parser-2.0.3-MIT.txt
- parse-svg-path 0.2.0 — MIT — parse-svg-path-0.2.0-MIT.txt
- tiny-lru 11.4.7 — BSD-3-Clause — tiny-lru-11.4.7-BSD-3-Clause.txt

Versions are taken from package-lock.json. PixiJS and all declared production
runtime transitive dependencies are listed, even where tree-shaking may omit a
specific module from a particular build. Type-only packages and build-only
TypeScript/esbuild tooling are not browser runtime dependencies. esbuild's
linked bundle notices remain alongside their respective emitted chunks under
/dist/.
